Subject: Joint evaluation playbook: SOC2 / SIG / DPA & close timeline - Aurora Financials

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for the call today. Attached is a first-pass joint evaluation playbook that captures the security & compliance gates Aurora flagged. Key gates and proposed owner/dates below (please confirm):

1) SOC 2 artifacts exchange (Redwood provides redacted Type II + bridge): target delivery 2027-01-04 — owner: Kimberly Park (Redwood)
2) SIG/CAIQ questionnaire completion (initial pass from Redwood + Aurora verify): target 2027-01-10 — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) + Aurora security
3) DPA redline and sign (Aurora legal to review Redwood-v2): propose Aurora redline by 2027-01-07, final sign by 2027-01-14 — owner: Irene Choi (Redwood) / Aurora Legal
4) Data retention alignment (transaction logs / ML telemetry): confirm retention tiers and export options by 2027-01-07 — owner: Ben Carter / Aurora engineers
5) Test account + smoke acceptance (functional + data-handling test): ready by 2027-01-12 — owner: Aurora / Redwood solutions engineering

Acceptance/close target: 2027-01-20 if sign-off by 2027-01-11.

Attachments included in this email: 20261222-Aurora-Joint-Eval-Playbook.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet) and SOC2-bridge-chart.pdf (controls map). I also attached the latest DPA-v2 with our suggested edits for visibility (Aurora legal will see a slightly redlined copy coming from Irene).

Notes on data retention (short summary here; details in the spreadsheet): Aurora requested a 7-year retention for transaction ledger data. Redwood platform provides configurable retention tiers: default token/log retention 90–180 days; extended retention tiers (1, 3, 7 years) are available as a paid tier with export or archival options. We’ll document export flows and support customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest where required.

Next steps: please confirm the dates above and any mandatory evidence items not listed. If Aurora prefers, we can establish a weekly 30-min sync starting the week of Jan 4.

Best,
Mateo

Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Joint evaluation playbook: SOC2 / SIG / DPA & close timeline - Aurora Financials

Mateo — thanks for the plan and attachments. Quick clarifications from Aurora Security / Legal: 

- SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge if Type II not available) and a control mapping that ties our scoped data classes (payment/transaction PII, account IDs) to Redwood controls. Will the SOC2-bridge-chart include those mappings?

- SIG/CAIQ: we prefer the questionnaire as a CSV exportable format. Is Redwood able to provide the SIG answers in CSV (we’ll ingest into our vendor portal)?

- DPA: please send the DPA-v2 redline to legal@aurorafin.com. We will redline and revert. A couple of must-haves from our side: (a) support for 7-year retention on transaction ledger exports; (b) an explicit definition of encryption key ownership (do you offer customer-managed keys / HSM integration?).

- Data boundaries: we need confirmation that debug logs and KV cache content do not contain long-lived customer PII by default. If any logs do, we need an exportable audit trail and a deletion SLA (requested: 30 days for debug logs unless Aurora opts-in to longer retention).

Proposed meeting: week of Jan 11 for final review and sign-off. Is Jan 11–13 open for you?

Thanks — I’ll loop Legal on the DPA thread once we review Irene’s redline.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Security Operations | Aurora Financial Services
elena.park@aurorafin.com

Hi all — quick status update on SOC2 artifacts and mapping: 

Deliverables we will provide by 2027-01-04 (per Mateo's plan):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- SOC2-to-Aurora-controls bridge (PDF) mapping Redwood controls to Aurora-scoped data classes (payment PII, account IDs)
- Penetration test summary (external vendor)
- Complementary user-entity controls list for Aurora to complete (CUCs)

Question for Ben: do we include KV cache retention details in the bridge mapping or treat caches as ephemeral and out-of-scope for SOC2 retention? My inclination is to mark KV caches as ephemeral by default and document the export/handover mechanism for any required ledger-like persistence.

If we need to include additional items for Aurora’s audit team (e.g., evidence of KMS configuration, key rotation cadence), flag it and I’ll add it to the delivery scope. I’m attaching the SOC2 bridge chart (SOC2-bridge-chart.pdf) for the Aurora mapping.

Subject: Re: Joint evaluation playbook: SOC2 / SIG / DPA & close timeline - Aurora Financials

Irene / Mateo — thanks for sending the DPA redline. A few high-level legal points from Aurora: 

1) Data retention: our legal/compliance team requires an express option for 7-year retention for transaction ledger data. Redwood can offer export + archival, but Aurora needs contract language guaranteeing the ability to retain for 7 years and to receive a usable export in standard formats (CSV/Parquet).

2) Key ownership: Aurora prefers customer-managed keys (CMK) via our KMS; we need confirmation that Redwood supports bring-your-own-key (BYOK) and HSM-backed key storage for production. Please confirm with a short tech note (KM-1) and any constraints.

3) Audit logs / deletion SLA: Aurora requires a deletion SLA for debug logs containing PII — default 30 days unless Aurora selects extended retention. Please add this to the DPA.

We will review Irene's redline and return a counter-redline by close of business 2027-01-06. Once DPA language is finalized, we will route the DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Regards,
Aurora Legal Team
legal@aurorafin.com

Subject: Finalized MAP & milestone confirmation — next steps to close (target 2027-01-20)

Hi all — thanks for the responses and the quick turnaround. This email confirms the agreed mutual action plan and next milestones so we have a single source of truth: 

Milestones / Owners / Acceptance criteria / Target dates

1) SOC2 artifacts uploaded to secure share — Owner: Kimberly Park (Redwood) — Acceptance: redacted Type II + bridge mapping for scoped data classes uploaded to Drive link — Target: 2027-01-04 (delivered)

2) SIG/CAIQ questionnaire — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) + Aurora Security — Acceptance: CSV export of Redwood answers + Aurora verification — Target: 2027-01-10

3) DPA executed — Owner: Irene Choi (Redwood) + Aurora Legal — Acceptance: fully signed DocuSign envelope (DPA + retention addendum) — Target: 2027-01-14 (Aurora to counter by 2027-01-06)

4) Data retention & KMS confirmation — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) — Acceptance: technical note on BYOK/HSM support and retention export process, and confirmation that debug logs default to 30 days unless Aurora opts-in — Target: 2027-01-06

5) Test account & smoke acceptance — Owner: Aurora / Redwood SE — Acceptance: test account provisioned, sample ingestion with ledger export validated — Target: 2027-01-12

Close target: 2027-01-20 if Aurora signs by 2027-01-11. 

Links / attachments (finalized MAP):
- https://drive.google.com/file/d/aurora-map-2026
- DocuSign envelope (when DPA countersigned): https://app.docusign.com/some/docusign/aurora
- Attachment: Aurora-DPA-v2-redline.docx

If that timeline works, please reply with a line of sign-off ("ACK to MAP and dates") and we will lock in the Jan 20 close target. If Aurora needs an alternate close cadence, we can adjust but will need to understand which gates slip and the impact to go-live.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Aurora across the finish line.

Best,
